Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 135. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Weapon Technique
Ki Cost: 100 Ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon
that you are proficient with & Spirit Bomb
Casting Time: Special
Range: Self
Duration: Special
Chargeable: No
When you would absorb Spirit Bomb, you may
channel the ki into your weapon. Your weapon’s
damage becomes half the amount of die value as the
Spirit Bomb. This technique has a duration of 1 round
per Spirit Bomb Rank. Once the duration of this
technique ends, you gain 9 ranks of exhaustion
